note: The feedback panel's Send step (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 20). SEND opens a review of exactly what will go out, and the open button hands it to the player's browser or email app; nothing is sent until the player submits it there. WHERE it goes is `_target`: none (the default: SEND is hidden and only COPY REPORT shows), mailto (a private email to `_targets.mailto.to`), form (a private form at `_targets.form.url`, with {title} and {body} where the text goes) or github (a PUBLIC issue on issue.repo, the review says so). The EP gives the address when Orb picks it. Each target carries its own words (open, review, opened) and its own link limit (browsers and proxies cut long ones); a report too long for it is copied to the clipboard instead and the link opens with a short body that asks to paste it. The github target's words are the top-level buttons.open, review and opened below. Keys starting with an underscore are UI's own (the schema ignores them).
